Squares $ABCD$, $EFGH$, and $GHIJ$ are equal in area. Points $C$ and $D$ are the midpoints of sides $IH$ ad $HE$, respectively. What is the ratio of the area of the shaded pentagon $AJICB$ to the sum of the areas of the three squares?

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the attached figure, it can be seen that the two lower squares EFGH and GHIJ are adjacent left and right, and share the vertical side HG; points E, D, H, C, I are on the same horizontal line. Square ABCD is located above this horizontal line, and its bottom side is DC. The outer boundary of the shaded region is, in order, A-J-I-C-B, then returning to A, forming pentagon AJICB. The problem also gives that D is the midpoint of HE, and C is the midpoint of IH. Reasoning: Let the common side length of the three equal-area squares be s. Establish a coordinate system according to the figure, let H=(0,0), E=(-s,0), I=(s,0), G=(0,-s), J=(s,-s). Because D is the midpoint of HE and C is the midpoint of IH, D=(-s/2,0), C=(s/2,0). The bottom side DC of square ABCD has length s, and is above, so A=(-s/2,s), B=(s/2,s). Use the coordinates of vertices A, J, I, C, B in the shoelace formula: A=(-s/2,s), J=(s,-s), I=(s,0), C=(s/2,0), B=(s/2,s). The shoelace calculation gives the area of pentagon AJICB as s^2. The total area of the three squares is 3s^2, therefore the desired ratio is s^2/(3s^2)=1/3.

raw_record.question_text: Squares $ABCD$, $EFGH$, and $GHIJ$ are equal in area. Points $C$ and $D$ are the midpoints of sides $IH$ and $HE$, respectively. What is the ratio of the area of the shaded pentagon $AJICB$ to the sum of the areas of the three squares?

method.method_draft: Use a coordinate model based on the diagram. First read from the image that the two lower squares EFGH and GHIJ are adjacent and share side HG, while square ABCD sits above the horizontal line E-D-H-C-I with DC as its bottom side; the shaded pentagon has boundary A-J-I-C-B. From the text, let the common side length of all three equal-area squares be s. Since D is the midpoint of HE and C is the midpoint of IH, assign coordinates H=(0,0), E=(-s,0), I=(s,0), G=(0,-s), J=(s,-s), D=(-s/2,0), C=(s/2,0), A=(-s/2,s), and B=(s/2,s). Then compute the area of pentagon AJICB using the shoelace formula on vertices A, J, I, C, B. This gives area s^2. The total area of the three squares is 3s^2, so the requested ratio is s^2/(3s^2)=1/3.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：附图中可以看到两个下方的正方形 EFGH 和 GHIJ 左右相邻，并且共用竖直边 HG；点 E、D、H、C、I 在同一条水平线上。正方形 ABCD 位于这条水平线的上方，其底边为 DC。阴影区域的外边界依次为 A-J-I-C-B，再回到 A，形成五边形 AJICB。题目还给出 D 是 HE 的中点，C 是 IH 的中点。推理：设三个等面积正方形的共同边长为 s。按图建立坐标系，令 H=(0,0)，E=(-s,0)，I=(s,0)，G=(0,-s)，J=(s,-s)。因为 D 是 HE 的中点，C 是 IH 的中点，所以 D=(-s/2,0)，C=(s/2,0)。正方形 ABCD 的底边 DC 长为 s，且在上方，所以 A=(-s/2,s)，B=(s/2,s)。用顶点 A、J、I、C、B 的坐标套用鞋带公式：A=(-s/2,s)，J=(s,-s)，I=(s,0)，C=(s/2,0)，B=(s/2,s)。鞋带计算得到五边形 AJICB 的面积为 s^2。三个正方形的总面积为 3s^2，因此所求比值为 s^2/(3s^2)=1/3。
